Governance Readiness Audit

Get your free Governance Report Card

A scored read on your AI risk, consent trail, audit readiness and escalation gaps. Ten questions, about a minute — and your score appears as you answer.

1. When the AI cannot answer something, is there a named person it goes to?
2. Does every AI answer show where the answer came from?
3. Is anything customer-facing held for approval before it goes out?
4. Can you name who is responsible for what the AI decides?
5. Is every action recorded — who, what, when?
6. Are there written acceptance criteria the AI is measured against?
7. Do you record consent before you call or message someone?
8. Does the AI refuse to answer outside your approved knowledge?
9. Could you leave your current setup and take your data with you?
10. Has anyone tested the AI against your exceptions, not just the happy path?
Your score
—

Ten questions, two points each. Nothing is sent until you ask for the full report card.
